question: In which state is cactus vegetation found in dry areas of Thorny Bushes in the form of spines?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Cactus vegetation is found in dry areas of Thorny Bushes in the form of spines in **Rajasthan**.
 
• **Rajasthan** is an arid area that receives less than **75 cm** of annual rainfall.
 
• This rainfall does not support **dense forests**.
 
• The loss of **moisture** is also high due to transpiration as the region has a high temperature.
 
• Trees have needle-shaped **thorns** to prevent loss of moisture.
 
• The **Thorn Forests** are also found in the semi-arid areas of Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Uttar Pradesh, and Haryana.
 
• **Acacias, palms, euphorbias, and cacti **are the main plants found in these forests.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajasthan** is a state in northern India. It is the **largest** Indian state by area and the **seventh** largest by population.
 
• **Jaipur** is the capital of India’s Rajasthan state. I
 
• **Bhajan Lal Sharma** is an Indian politician serving as the current Chief Minister of Rajasthan.
 
• **Ghoomar** or ghumar is a traditional folk dance of Rajasthan.
